title: The Hieroglyphic Parchment Segmenter
statement:
An epigrapher is translating an unspaced string S of length L. A known dictionary of K valid ancient words is provided.

Determine whether the string S can be segmented into a space-separated sequence of one or more dictionary words. The same word in the dictionary may be reused multiple times.

Print YES if valid segmentation is possible, otherwise print NO.
inputFormat:
First line: String S.
Second line: Integer K.
Third line: K space-separated dictionary words.
constraints:
1 <= len(S) <= 1000
1 <= K <= 1000
1 <= len(word) <= 50
All words contain lowercase letters.

sampleCases.explanation: "applepenapple" can be segmented as "apple pen apple".
